name: Eclipse Burst
body:
School evocation [cold, darkness]; Level cleric/oracle 8, druid/shaman 8, sorcerer/wizard 7, witch 7

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range long (400 ft. + 40 ft./level)
Area 60-foot burst
Duration Instantaneous
Saving Throw Reflex half; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You create a globe of vile cold that explodes in the area dealing 1d8 cold damage per 3 caster levels (maximum 6d8) and 1d8 negative energy damage per 3 caster levels (maximum 6d8). A successful Reflex save halves this damage.

Additionally, the burst of darkness snuffs out any non-magical light sources (except daylight) and dispels any spell of 5th level or lower with the light descriptor active in the area as if using a targeted dispel magic spell.
